mods.summary: Routes the game's AI calls to your own LLM - Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, OpenAI, OpenRouter, vLLM, Groq - instead of the hosted backend.
Import custom PNG and JPEG portraits into Character Creator with an in-game file explorer.
Party mod that fires random chaos events during your shift, with an optional Creator Mode where chat votes on what happens next. Host-only; friends don't need the mod.

postInstall.description: Downloads and installs ChatBridge so Creator Mode can read YouTube, TikTok and Kick chat and serve the OBS overlay. Skipping leaves the mod installed but Creator Mode locked.

mods.summary: Lets the lobby host control the boss presentation, slides, quota, quotes and recordings. Use the BepInEx plugin release; remove legacy HostBoss disk patches before switching.
Adds a Plugins tab to the in-game menu (F1), listing every installed plugin with a switch for each.
The library the mods are built against. Installed on its own it does nothing; it is here so the first mod you install brings it with it.
When you fail the quota, you get swatted by police officers, if they catch you, you get reset back to Day 1.
Let Twitch viewers join and control incoming scam calls through chat, with spoken replies, code interaction, and an optional OBS overlay. Also Includes shift-length settings.
